description: This file contains the implementation of the Reward class which is part of the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to calculate total reward points, confirm reward-based discounts, and unconfirm rewards related to customer orders.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: A model class in OpenCart that manages reward points adding, confirming, and unconfirming logic during checkout and order processing. It extends the engine's base model class.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and applies reward points discounts to the order total if the customer has enough reward points. It updates the totals and taxes accordingly.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms the reward points used for an order, deducting them from the customer's reward points balance and recording the reward application.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes the reward points associated with an order, restoring the reward points to the customer if the order is canceled or modified.
